name: Jovial Grain-Free Cassava Penne (AIP Friendly)
whyItWorks: Made solely with organic cassava flour and water. Completely grain-free, corn-free, and wheat-free; excellent hypoallergenic staple for patients on strict elimination protocols.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil in salted water for 12–13 minutes stirring occasionally. Cassava pasta cooks slightly firmer, so give it extra time until fully tender.
